result.summary: Updates the project's clang-format configuration to set AllowShortLoopsOnASingleLine to true and AlwaysBreakTemplateDeclarations to No. This relaxes formatting rules to align with existing coding patterns used across the codebase.
result.problem: The existing clang-format rules enforce multi-line splits for short loops and template declarations, which developers frequently bypass in practice. Running clang-format locally creates unwanted diff churn on these patterns, and enforcing them adds unnecessary review friction.
evidence: Author grepped src/ to find 111 instances of single-line loops and 162 instances of inline template declarations already present in the codebase (PR description)
result.card: Relaxes the repository's clang-format configuration to permit single-line loops and inline template declarations. The strict configuration conflicts with existing code and common developer habits, producing unwanted diff churn during local formatting and unnecessary review friction. Grep evidence cited by the author shows over 100 single-line loops and over 160 inline template declarations already in src/.

risk.why: A mistake only changes how clang-format formats code locally for developers.
